title: Input and output
description:
Write a program that asks for a name and a birth year with a `Scanner`, then greets the person and says how old they turn in 2026:

```
Name? Ada
Birth year? 1990
Hello, Ada!
In 2026 you turn 36.
```

The prompts are printed with `System.out.print` (no line break). Read both answers with `nextLine()` and convert the year with `Integer.parseInt`.
hints: `import java.util.Scanner;` goes at the very top of the file, above the class.
Put the subtraction in parentheses: `"turn " + 2026 - year` would try to subtract from a string.

examples.name: Ada
examples.expected:
Name? Birth year? Hello, Ada!
In 2026 you turn 36.

examples.name: a two-word name
examples.expected:
Name? Birth year? Hello, Grace Hopper!
In 2026 you turn 16.
